s1.syndrome_frame: Multiple skin-colored papules on the face and vulva with a gradual increase in number over time
salient_findings: Multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored papules on the face and vulva
Family history of similar facial papules
Histopathology showing buds and cords of basaloid cells with small cystic spaces
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 60s
Lesions first appeared around 50 years of age
Approximately 60 lesions are present
Lesions are located on the face and vulva
No palmar or plantar pits were observed
Medical history includes a meningioma
Family history includes a daughter with similar facial papules
Histopathology of lesions shows basaloid cells with small cystic spaces
Genetic testing revealed a conserved splice-site mutation in the SUFU gene
